stops.name: puerto natural
stops.quote: Durante los siglos XIII y XIV, la isla de Cabrera y su puerto natural eran utilizados por piratas berberiscos como base desde donde atacar las costas mallorquinas.
stops.english: During the 13th and 14th centuries, the island of Cabrera and its natural port were used by Barbary pirates as a base from which to attack the Mallorcan coasts.

stops.name: castillo
stops.quote: Por este motivo, ya en el siglo XIV, se construyó un castillo en la entrada del puerto.
stops.english: For this reason, back in the 14th century, a castle was built at the entrance of the port.

stops.name: monolito
stops.quote: debido a la escasez de recursos de la isla y a la falta de suministros por parte de las autoridades de la Junta de Defensa de Mallorca, no más de la mitad seguían vivos al finalizar la guerra; y en recuerdo de estos prisioneros, se erigió un monolito en la isla.
stops.english: due to the island's scarcity of resources and the lack of supplies from the Mallorca Defense Board authorities, no more than half were still alive at the end of the war; and in memory of these prisoners, a monolith was erected on the island.

stops.name: museo
stops.quote: Para ello construyeron una bodega, que se utiliza actualmente como museo.
stops.english: For this purpose they built a winery, which is currently used as a museum.

stops.name: Cabrera
stops.quote: La mayor en superficie es Cabrera, seguida de Conejera.
stops.english: The largest in surface area is Cabrera, followed by Conejera.

stops.name: Conejera
stops.quote: La mayor en superficie es Cabrera, seguida de Conejera.
stops.english: The largest in surface area is Cabrera, followed by Conejera.

stops.name: cuevas submarinas
stops.quote: Sus aguas sorprenden por su excepcional transparencia y visibilidad, por sus cuevas submarinas, en las que siguen apareciendo especies sin catalogar, como son varios crustáceos endémicos descubiertos en aguas de una cueva.
stops.english: Its waters surprise with their exceptional transparency and visibility, and for their underwater caves, in which uncatalogued species continue to appear, such as several endemic crustaceans discovered in the waters of a cave.
